name: A user without Access Management permission sees no User & Access navigation
description:
Objective: A user without Access Management permission sees no User & Access navigation.
Preconditions: Open Role enforcement with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Role enforcement.
2. A user without Access Management permission sees no User & Access navigation.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: The invalid or unauthorized action is rejected and no unintended state change is made.
